comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record snaps a lid around a full paper cup rim.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses localized blade insertion and coordinated axial extraction; record progressively seats multiple snap sectors while stabilizing a deformable, spillable cup.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective extraction; record requires all rim sectors seated with no cup tipping, lifting, squeezing, or off-cup lid closure.
comparison.reason: Progressive circumferential snap fitting and vessel stabilization are different tested abilities.
